abstract:
BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is associated with poor survival even after resection. We synthesized biomarker associations with overall survival in surgically resected PDAC.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase and the Cochrane Library were searched through December 2025 and updated in June 2026. Category-level hazard ratios (HRs) were pooled using restricted maximum likelihood random-effects models with Hartung-Knapp confidence intervals; heterogeneity, prediction intervals and targeted sensitivity analyses were evaluated.
RESULTS: After excluding two advanced/metastatic-population reports during eligibility verification, the eight quantitative syntheses comprised 62 HR estimates from 49 contributing publications. Six of eight categories had statistically significant pooled associations. CA19-9 was associated with overall survival (HR 1.79, 95% CI 1.38-2.32; I2 = 96.0%), while CEA (HR 1.69, 95% CI 1.30-2.21) was supported by only three publications (I2 = 0%; prediction interval 1.17-2.44). Inflammatory markers yielded HR 1.75 (95% CI 1.45-2.12) with I2 = 0%, although markers differed biologically.
CONCLUSIONS: The findings identify prognostic associations but do not establish incremental prediction or clinical benefit. Prospective, marker-specific validation remains necessary.
REGISTRATION: OSF, doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/U5Y73.
key_points_ko: CA19-9 상승은 수술 후 전체 생존기간 악화와 유의미하게 연관되었습니다(위험비 1.79, 95% 신뢰구간 1.38-2.32).
CEA 상승 또한 생존기간 악화와 연관성을 보였습니다(위험비 1.69, 95% 신뢰구간 1.30-2.21).
염증성 마커(Inflammatory markers)도 유의미한 위험비 상승을 나타냈습니다(위험비 1.75, 95% 신뢰구간 1.45-2.12).
summary_ko: 수술적 절제를 받은 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자의 전체 생존기간(OS)과 예후 바이오마커 간의 연관성을 분석한 연구입니다. 49개 연구에서 도출된 62개의 위험비(HR) 추정치를 바탕으로 메타분석을 진행했습니다. 분석된 8개 바이오마커 카테고리 중 6개에서 통계적으로 유의미한 연관성이 확인되었습니다. 다만 이 결과가 임상적 이점을 직접 증명하지는 않으므로 전향적 검증이 필요하다고 밝혔습니다.
title: Circulating, Genetic, and Tissue-Based Prognostic Biomarkers for Overall Survival in Surgically Resected Pancreatic Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
title_ko: 수술로 절제된 췌장암 환자의 전체 생존기간에 대한 순환, 유전적 및 조직 기반 예후 바이오마커: 체계적 문헌고찰 및 메타분석
